name: Continental Controls Limited
about: Continental Controls Limited provides advisory services on real estate and technology-driven activities in India. The company focuses on developing and implementing integrated software platforms for retail businesses, including solutions for digital commerce, inventory management, customer engagement, supplier connectivity, logistics integration, and business analytics. The company also offers Ready Pharmacy and Ready Shopping, which caters to standalone pharmacies, grocery stores, apparel outlets, and local retail. Continental Controls Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Thane, India.
